    # Check unique worker and job
    workers = [x['worker'] for x in sel]
    jobs = [x['job'] for x in sel]
    if len(set(workers)) != 3:
        continue
    if len(set(jobs)) != 3:
        continue
    # Check cover job j0,j1,j2
    job_set = set(jobs)
    if not all(j in job_set for j in ['j0','j1','j2']):
        continue
    # Check requires closure
    # For each selected option, all requires must be in sel_ids
    valid_requires = True
    for x in sel:
        for r in x['requires']:
            if r not in sel_ids:
                valid_requires = False
                break
        if not valid_requires:
            break
    if not valid_requires:
        continue
    # Check no_conflicts is false, so no need to check conflicts
    # Check sum_bounds empty, so no sum constraints
    # Check order_by empty, so no order constraints
    # Check min_count and max_count = 3, already 3
    # Check valid(sel_ids) per goal
    if valid(sel_ids):
        result = sel_ids
        break
